title: TanStack Start
notes: TanStack Start built with Vite and Nitro's Node server, as its hosting guide says. /about is prerendered at build time. Nitro 3 is a beta release.
details: Built with vite build and the Nitro plugin, as the hosting guide says for Node.js; the Nitro node-server output (.output/server/index.mjs) is imported into the measured process, on Bun and Deno as on Node. The server underneath is a pre-release: Nitro 3 is a beta and its h3 a release candidate, the versions the framework's guide installs. The port is passed through NITRO_PORT (0, for a free one) and the host through NITRO_HOST, and the port is read from the line the server prints when it listens. Not a default: /about is prerendered by Nitro's prerender option, because the page TanStack Start's own prerender option writes is not served by this server.
